beamtel_accessibility_status_up.title: Accessibility menu up
beamtel_accessibility_status_up.desc: Move to and announce the previous available status item.

beamtel_accessibility_status_down.title: Accessibility menu down
beamtel_accessibility_status_down.desc: Move to and announce the next available status item.

beamtel_accessibility_status_repeat.title: Accessibility menu repeat
beamtel_accessibility_status_repeat.desc: Announce the fresh value of the selected status item without moving.
